item.title: 'COWARDS': Trump Loses It as NATO Rejects His Plea for Help in Iran War
item.description: Donald Trump is spiraling publicly after NATO allies refused to jump into his administration’s escalating conflict with Iran—and he’s not even trying to hide it. Instead, he’s unloading.

item.title: WATCH: Visibly Worn Trump Boasts Doctor Says He Could Live to 200—and Beat Obama on Health
item.description: Donald Trump, bruised and visibly worn, is now floating a new claim: he might live to 200—at least according to one of his most controversial allies.

item.title: Trump Makes Humiliating U-Turn on Bombing Threat as Iran Calls Out His BS And 48-Hour Ultimatum Falls Flat
item.description: Donald Trump spent the weekend beating his chest about bombing Iran. By Monday morning, he was hitting the brakes. Hard. After issuing a 48-hour ultimatum threatening to “obliterate” Iran if it didn’t reopen the Strait of Hormuz—a key global oil route—Trump abruptly reversed course just hours before his own deadline expired.

item.title: Trump Claims He Reached Deal With ‘Top Person’ in Iran to End War —Tehran Calls It Fiction
item.description: Donald Trump says he’s reached a deal to end the war with Iran. Iran says none of it is real. That’s where things stand right now—two completely conflicting narratives, both delivered publicly, both impossible to square.

item.title: And Just Like That —Poof— the Epstein–Trump Story Got Buried Under War, Chaos, and Convenient Crises
item.description: Funny how this works. One minute, the Epstein files are exploding across headlines—millions of documents, new allegations, missing records, bipartisan outrage. The next? Gone. Replaced by war. Panic. Chaos. Nonstop breaking news.

item.title: FBI Director Kash Patel's Personal Email Breached by Iran-Linked Hackers, Private Photos and Resume Leaked
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel just got hit with the kind of breach his own agency is supposed to stop. Hackers tied to Iran claim they broke into Patel’s personal email—and they’re not being subtle about it.

item.title: Trump Brings Struggling Farmers to White House to Brag He’s Saving Them—from the Damage He Caused
item.description: Nothing says “problem solved” like inviting the people you’ve squeezed the hardest to the White House and telling them they should be thankful for it.

item.title: Trump Renames Strait of Hormuz After Himself, Rants About Nobel Peace Prize in Rambling Speech
item.description: Donald Trump took the stage in Miami and somehow managed to turn a foreign policy crisis into a branding exercise—while complaining he still doesn’t have a Nobel Prize.

item.title: Kristi Noem's ‘Glamour Shots’ Removed From DHS Halls — Staff Celebrate
item.description: Days after Kristi Noem was pushed out of the Department of Homeland Security, the walls started changing—and inside the building, people were apparently more than happy to help.

item.title: Mass GOP Exodus: Record Number of House Republicans Quit as Trump’s Chaos Engulfs Washington
item.description: An unprecedented wave of House Republican retirements is reshaping the political landscape in Washington, complicating Speaker Mike Johnson’s (R-La.) bid to fend off a potential blue wave in the 2026 midterms and preserve his razor-thin majority.

item.title: ‘Trouble is Brewing’: Another Top Republican Quits as GOP Braces for Big Losses in Midterms
item.description: Signs of mounting trouble for Republicans are growing clearer, as another senior GOP lawmaker heads for the exits and party leaders brace for steep losses in the upcoming midterm elections.

item.title: WATCH: Marco Rubio Scrambles to Save Face After Contradicting Trump on Iran
item.description: A tense interview on ABC’s Good Morning America put Secretary of State Marco Rubio on the defensive as anchor George Stephanopoulos pressed him over apparent contradictions with President Donald Trump on Iran.

item.title: 'Brainwashing Boomers': MAGA Turns on Fox News For Peddling 'Fake News' To Justify Iran War
item.description: The Republican civil war over Iran has taken a dramatic turn as former Trump loyalist Marjorie Taylor Greene publicly blasted Fox News for promoting what she called “fake news” to justify Donald Trump’s military plans in the region.

item.title: Trump-Epstein Scandal Explodes Back Into Headlines After FBI Corroborates Claims Against Trump by 13-Year-Old Accuser
item.description: The Trump-Epstein scandal is roaring back into the spotlight, even as the U.S. is embroiled in the war in Iran. A new investigation has corroborated elements of the testimony of a woman who claims Donald Trump sexually abused her when she was 13.

item.title: Trump Approval Sinks to New Low as Voters Reject Iran War and Rising Prices
item.description: Donald Trump’s approval rating has plunged to a new low, according to a fresh poll—and his handling of the escalating Iran war is dragging him down even further.
